steps: Client and server present certificates during the handshake.
Each validates chain, name, lifetime, and proof of private-key possession.
Handshake derives session keys for encrypted transport.
Application maps the authenticated peer identity to authorization policy.

lesson.scenario: A settlement client and ledger server authenticate each other before exchanging bank instructions.

steps.title: Load short-lived identities
steps.narration: The CA issues distinct certificates whose SANs name settlement and ledger workloads.

client.detail: No work accepted in this phase

server.detail: No work accepted in this phase

steps.outcome: Neither workload shares a symmetric secret.
steps.invariant: Both peers validate chain, lifetime, key usage, and exact workload SAN; mTLS authentication is followed by action authorization.

steps.title: Verify the ledger server
steps.narration: The client validates chain, expiry, key usage, and exact ledger SPIFFE SAN before sending settlement bytes.
steps.outcome: The caller knows it reached the intended workload.
steps.invariant: Both peers validate chain, lifetime, key usage, and exact workload SAN; mTLS authentication is followed by action authorization.

steps.title: Verify the settlement client
steps.narration: Ledger validates the client chain and exact settlement SPIFFE identity, not merely any certificate from the CA.
steps.outcome: The server has a cryptographic caller identity.
steps.invariant: Both peers validate chain, lifetime, key usage, and exact workload SAN; mTLS authentication is followed by action authorization.

steps.title: Authorize after authentication
steps.narration: Ledger policy permits settlement to submit, but not approve, instruction S-771 for USD 12,000.
steps.invariant: Both peers validate chain, lifetime, key usage, and exact workload SAN; mTLS authentication is followed by action authorization.

steps.title: Rotate the channel identity
steps.narration: The client opens new connections with C82 while existing C81 sessions drain before expiry.
steps.outcome: Certificate renewal avoids a fleet-wide reconnect cliff.
